sloka: निर्मलेन सुधौतेन खड्गेनास्य महच्छिरः ।जघान वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य वालिसूनुर्महाबलः ।। ६.५४.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: nirmalena sudhautena khaḍgenāsya mahacchiraḥ ।jaghāna vajradaṁṣṭrasya vālisūnurmahābalaḥ ।। 6.54.35 ।।।।

translations.english: His (Vajradamshtra's) limbs bathed in blood, cut off by sword, eyeballs rolling cleft into two dropped down.
